**বাংলায়:** সাধারণ ডিফল্ট সেট: ক্যাটাগরি, ডেলিভারি ব্যান্ড, মেসেজ টেমপ্লেট; টাকার ঘর খালি থাকে। নতুন সার্ভারে মূল দোকান নিজে তৈরি হয়, তাই প্রথম লগইনেই অ্যাডমিন খোলে। 23 Oct: অ্যাডমিন লগইন পুরো যাচাই: লগইন, রিফ্রেশ, লগইন থাকা অবস্থায় লগইন পাতা, লগআউট, প্রতিবার CI-তে আসল ব্রাউজারে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-20
  - Build status row: general default pack (`packages/seed/data/default-pack.json`): garment types, 7 categories (hidden), 3 delivery bands (off, no charge), 14 SMS/WhatsApp/e-mail templates (Bengali + English, 2 SMS + 1 WhatsApp on, later steps off); policy, AI and theme settings in the registry; money and COD left empty for the owner; add-only, re-run changes nothing. 23 Oct (follow-up 19, from closed GitHub #21): the admin session end to end in CI (`tools/admin-session-e2e.sh`, web job with a postgres service): sign in, refresh, `/admin/login` while signed in, log out, a protected page and the pre-logout cookie both sent back to sign-in; no console error or failed request on the way
  - GitHub pull request #24, 23 Oct
  - GitHub pull request #19, 20 Oct
  - GitHub pull request #10 (commit `b5fe56d`), 20 Oct 05:20 (Dhaka)
- **What it does (original scope):** **General default pack** — policy shapes, charge structures, category structure, SMS and email template text, AI settings, theme, roles, seeded as editable defaults on every installation
- **Filed under:** [S00 additions — the settings framework (approved 18 Oct)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s00-additions--the-settings-framework-approved-18-oct)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **20 Oct 14:15** · [Scope added to existing PRs (owner, urgent admin sign-in bug; no new PR numbers)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-621): **PR 508 (general default pack)** — a fresh installation gets its mother store in the migrate step (`seed cli.ts mother-store`, before `pack --all-stores`): a draft at `MOTHER_STORE_ID`, address from the pack (`motherStore.slug`), language, time zone and currency from the registry defaults, no name (owner data, PR 509). Without it every admin page failed after the first sign-in ("This page couldn't load"). Idempotent; refuses when stores exist but none is the mother store.
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `packages/seed/data/default-pack.json`, `tools/admin-session-e2e.sh`
  - Routes: `/admin/login`
  - Tests: 23 Oct (follow-up 19, from closed GitHub #21): the admin session end to end in CI (`tools/admin-session-e2e.sh`, web job with a postgres service): sign in, refresh, `/admin/login` while signed in, log out, a protected page and the pre-logout cookie both sent back to sign-in
- **Owning agent:** Prohori

## PR 603

**Database performance pack — required indexes, pg_trgm, slow query log, slowest-queries page, report materialized views and low-priority …**

**বাংলায়:** দ্রুত খোঁজার জন্য ডাটাবেসে ইনডেক্স, আর রিপোর্টের হিসাব আগে থেকে করে রাখা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-20
  - Build status row: index pack in the schema (category page, variant by colour/size, order by phone, history, list filters, style hierarchy), `pg_trgm` GIN indexes, 4 report materialized views
  - GitHub pull request #4 (commit `3122834`), 20 Oct 03:39 (Dhaka)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Database performance pack (owner server spec, 19 Oct 23:33).** Built with the schema (PR 13). **Required indexes:** category page (category + store + in-stock + sort, one index); SKU and variant by colour and size; order by phone (runs on every order for the fraud engine); fuzzy name/address with **`pg_trgm`** (the fraud/duplicate engine, PR 519); customer order history; style hierarchy for profit (Polo → brand polo → solid polo, PR 536); order list filters (date, status, courier, store). **Slow query log** for anything over 100 ms, target under 50 ms for a normal query, and an admin **"slowest queries"** page (PR 423). **Reports** (profit, ads, dashboard charts) run on **materialized views** refreshed on a schedule, or on a low-priority report pool, so they never slow the shop. Site search stays on Meilisearch (PR 72). Pre-launch required — nothing deferred.
- **Filed under:** [S00 addition — database performance pack (owner server spec, 19 Oct 23:33; CN-001)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s00-addition--database-performance-pack-owner-server-spec-19-oct-2333-cn-001)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **19 Oct 23:33** · [Scope added to existing PRs (owner server spec, CN-001; review/SERVER-SETUP-SPEC-OWNER.md; new PR 601–604)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-621): **The filing** — the owner approved every point of the analysis at 23:33 and said: where two decisions conflict, take the best one. Four new PRs (601 NVMe boot unit and 604 hardware-aware profile in S0A, 603 database performance pack in S00, 602 four-layer cache in S02); the rest is dated scope on the PR lines below (PR 1, 3–10, 13, 18, 22, 24, 37, 72, 88, 234, 519). **Every server item is required before go-live** — the owner's "later" list (monitoring page, monthly speed measurement, report pre-computation) is not deferred; items that need the app schema are built with their stage and marked *pre-launch required*. **Build order inside S0A:** 1 record specs (PR 1) → 2 hardening and UFW (PR 3) → 3 NVMe boot unit (PR 601) → 4 data-disk LVM (PR 1/3) → 5 Docker (PR 4) → 6 hardware-aware profile (PR 604) → 7 Postgres, PgBouncer and Redis tuning (PR 5, 6) → 8 Caddy, Cloudflare and Origin …
  - **20 Oct** · [Scope added to existing PRs (V2.1 final · 20 Oct — pre-code demo work finished; blueprint V2.1 final; no new PR numbers)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-621): **Server admin pages in the demo (CN-001; sample numbers, labelled)** — `#/admin/server` → PR 423 / 601 / 603 / 604; `#/admin/cache` → PR 602; `#/admin/images` → PR 22 / 24 / 88; `#/admin/speed` → PR 234; `#/admin/integrations` ("Keys & connections") → PR 493 / 500; `#/admin/backup` now shows Blob + Drive → PR 8 / 395 / 507. Checks: 120 route/modal checks 0 fails + 19 flows.
